text: どんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで　トレーナーの　じつりょくが　とわれます！

structure.jp: どんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで
structure.en: by what kind of moves you have them learn

structure.jp: トレーナーの　じつりょくが

patterns.name: 〜かで
patterns.explanation: か wraps up a question inside the sentence, and で says the result depends on the answer to it. どんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで = 'depending on which moves you have it learn'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb says you make or have someone do it. おぼえさせる = 'have it learn'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending turns the verb around so the thing is on the receiving end of the action. とわれます = 'is questioned, is tested'.
